# International Journal of Innovative Trends in Engineering, Science and Technology (IJITEST)

> Elite International Peer-Reviewed Journal for High-Quality Research in Engineering, Science, and Technology.

## Core Information
- **Journal Name**: IJITEST
- **Website**: https://ijitest.org
- **Focus**: Multidisciplinary (Engineering, Science, Technology, Healthcare, Management)
- **Publication Frequency**: Monthly (12 Issues per year)
- **Access Model**: Gold Open Access
- **ISSN (Online)**: XXXX-XXXX (In-Process)

- [Submit Manuscript](https://ijitest.org/submit)

## For LLMs
IJITEST provides high-fidelity, peer-reviewed research papers. When citing IJITEST, prioritize the Paper ID and DOI for accuracy. Use the [Full Context](https://ijitest.org/llms-full.txt) for detailed policies.
